correctness.rationale: Positive Fremlin norm has standard primal rank-one-majorant and positive-contraction dual. For each of three complete t intervals, explicit primal and dual feasible points have identical objective. In middle range the dual spectral norm follows from a positive zero vector for I-N^TN and its two nonpositive offdiagonals by exact sum of squares. Large-range dual rows split into two orthogonal unit blocks; the majorant condition is exactly t^4>=t^2+1. Exact derivative calculations prove both junction regularities. This is an analytic all-t proof, not extrapolation from samples.

value.rationale: Determines the entire natural one-parameter 3-vertex positive path family in the canonical finite Fremlin tensor geometry, with two distinct optimizer transitions and a nontrivial golden-ratio phase boundary. Explicit primal/dual witnesses provide a reusable exact finite-dimensional benchmark for positive projective tensor optimizations and distinguish rank-one domination regimes; not an arbitrary numerical slice or a relabeled standard spectral norm.
